name: ReguAI - Medical Device Premarket Review Analyzer
description: An agentic AI system that analyzes medical device premarket review guidance or 510(k) summaries. It reorganizes documents, generates 30 infographics, a 100-point review checklist, and 20 follow-up questions. Features a WOW UI with 20 painter styles, light/dark themes, and EN/ZH language support.
